name: MSTR Tower
text: The tallest building in Base City. On every Payday it throws MSTR stock certificates over the streets.
withCashy: Cashy’s pool is paired with MSTR, Strategy’s stock. 0.85% of every Cashy trade goes to holders, paid in MSTR, on each Payday.

name: Feel.cash Exchange
text: The trading floor of Base City, wrapped in a live ticker band, with twin towers for every stock and the coin paired with it. Where stocks meet internet culture.
withCashy: Cashy launches on Feel.cash, paired with MSTR. Every Cashy trade runs through Feel.cash, and the holders’ share of the fees is paid in MSTR stock.

name: iPod Store
text: A giant white iPod rising from a dark stage. Apple is the company. IPOD is the culture.
withCashy: “Buy an iPod for cash”: a crossover between Cashy and IPOD, the Apple-paired coin on Feel.cash, with shared art and joint contests.

name: City Guide tower
text: The lookout over Base City. Open the guide for the list of places, the partners and how to get around.

name: Cashy
text: Base City’s own money. He walks the streets and hops across the rooftops. Cash in. MSTR out.

name: Printer Factory
text: Home of the Base Printer: how Cashy works, Payday history and Print my receipt.

name: Cashy Arcade
text: A building shaped like an arcade cabinet. Cashy Tower and Cashy Invaders live here. How high can you go, and how many waves can you clear?

name: Bank
text: Holder ranks: banknote tiers based on how much and how long you hold.

name: Open plot
text: A cultural Base project that joins gets a building here, designed around its own identity, and its characters move into the streets.

name: Reserved building
text: Held for a Base project that joins Base City. It turns solid when the project moves in.

name: Base project
text: A Base community that moved in. Its characters walk the streets instead of the bots.

name: Base Park
text: A green square for community events, meetups and weekly calls.
